description: List the medical inquiries the member sent to a doctor or clinic office, with their status. These are clinical questions and their answers, not reimbursement or approval paperwork - that is maccabi_administrative_requests. Each row carries a `ref` for maccabi_detail, which reads the patient and clinician text. An automatic_sick_permit row is list-only: its document is the row's own pdf_reference, passed to maccabi_document as `reference`. Nothing is submitted, cancelled, answered or marked read.
name: maccabi_doctor_inquiries
